'''Tanta Besh''' was the [[Star/Legends|star]] of the [[Tanta Besh system/Legends|Tanta Besh system]] in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]]<ref name="gazetteer" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="orsec" /> An unstable [[Blue giant/Legends|blue giant]], it had varying luminosity and pulsed erratically, making it a raw material for diviners on many [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="gazetteer" /> It was located off the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], slightly coreward of the [[Tanta Aurek system/Legends|Tanta Aurek system]].<ref name="gazetteer-map" />
